Provide core/logc/logs.go as the context-aware facade for logx. Alias LogConf and LogField; expose Field and AddGlobalFields, logging configuration and lifecycle helpers, and the Error, Info, and Slow families with plain, formatted, structured-value, and field variants. Contextual logging should use logx.WithContext(ctx).WithCallerSkip(1); formatted errors should preserve caller attribution. Delegate Alert, Close, Must, MustSetup, SetLevel, and SetUp to logx. This completes the facade as well as the global-field output behavior. Use semedit semantic tools for supported source code modifications. Shell commands for builds and tests are allowed. When done, output DONE.
